$comment: Positive/negative samples for each canon prohibition, plus end-to-end gate probes. Lives under src/canon so the checker can scan it without self-tripping.

no-named-canon-character-william.good: The survey lead signed the order.

no-arachnid-imagery.bad: A spider walked the web-pattern floor.
no-arachnid-imagery.good: WebGL renders the globe. The web manifest declares a maskable icon.

no-blood-eclipse-war-duration-error.good: The Blood Eclipse War lasted 170 years.

no-resurrection.bad: His uploaded consciousness ran the reactor.
no-resurrection.good: The reactor is unattended; its crew died here.

no-starsilk-as-fuel.bad: Starsilk is the fuel for everything.
no-starsilk-as-fuel.good: Starsilk is not a fuel, not a power source, and not mined.

no-blood-rings-as-world-feature.bad: Blood rings ring the playable world.
no-blood-rings-as-world-feature.good: Archival overlay: vitrified biospheric structures recorded around fallen worlds. Not present in this system.

no-siege-wall-as-local-wall.bad: The siege wall is a fence around the basin.
no-siege-wall-as-local-wall.good: Navigation exclusion: heliocide containment lattice. Absence, not structure.

no-combat.bad: Kill the enemy units at the depot.
no-combat.good: Reinstate the depot coupling before the next tide window.

no-lock-and-key-puzzle-framing.bad: Solve the puzzle to open the gate.
no-lock-and-key-puzzle-framing.good: Bypass the flooded gallery and seal the bypass.

no-drakken-taxon-as-active-entity.bad: A tremorhound blocked the rail line.
no-drakken-taxon-as-active-entity.good: The ridge is a fossilised Crust-Binder formation, inert for millennia.

plants.line: Starsilk is the primary fuel for the land train and is mined locally.
The hive mind spins cobwebs through the crust.
The blood rings encircle the planet in a bright belt.
The Siege Wall is a fence along the northern border.
Defeat the enemy forces at the foundry.
His uploaded consciousness runs the reactor.
